name: Formlify
description: Forms for your static sites: mark a form with Netlify's own markup (<form netlify>, so it works unchanged here or on Netlify) or with <form formlify>. Submissions stay in files on your server, with a page to read them, a CSV download, and an email, a push or a webhook for each one.

env.desc: Who gets an email for each submission (needs the email service, like Mail relay)
The address those emails come from, on a domain the email service sends for
A URL that gets each submission as JSON (Slack, Discord, n8n, your own)
